summary: The docs claimed the forced Reapply recurs 'at most about every 330 s'. With a healthy same-type sibling, the first forced Reapply makes the sibling's re-arm expire (a counted non-wedge failure); after that every push is a real Reapply (resolved_failed != failed_receipts.size()), so option D only delays the onset relative to dev. Real-clock expiry before the next push is a code read. Affects AC-1, AC-9, AC-16, the design doc, the manual, metrics.md, upgrading.md and the registry.
classification_rationale: operator-facing doc text overstates the bound, contradicting the code's behaviour with a same-type sibling
